dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: There you are... I've been looking everywhere for you.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Oh, no. I was just looking for a piece of alchemy equipment we needed for the event.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Master Albedo has always been careful with our costs. We maximize the use of every piece of lab equipment we have. So, if something hasn't been used in a while, it's usually pretty old.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Take this, for example. We've used it a few times before, but we found the effectiveness and ease of use somewhat lacking, so it was sidelined quite quickly.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: According to the mages, it was meant to be placed in the city, but it went missing after being tossed into the magic bubble.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Luckily, I found it... I just don't know why it ended up here of all places.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, all that matters is that you found it in the end, right? We'll contact Nicole and get her to send it back to the right spot.

choices.text: Not sure I remember this incident...
